component.name: Ferrous Lineup
component.summary: Play songs with a backing band and learn harmony
Toca canciones con una banda de acompañamiento y aprende armonía

description.p: Type the chords of a song on the chord sheet, pick a style, and a band (bass, drums, piano and more) plays it in any key and tempo. Every part lands on a track of its own, and a playlist, a step sequencer and a piano roll let you write or change any of it by hand.

The app names every chord you hear, with its numeral and function, and speaks the other languages of harmony too: pitch-class sets, twelve-tone rows and Kröpfl's micromodes. Count-in, metronome, loops, slower playback and leaving a part out make it a practice tool as well as a writing one.

Escribe los acordes de una canción en la hoja de acordes, elige un estilo y una banda (bajo, batería, piano y más) la tocará en cualquier tonalidad y tempo. Cada parte se ubica en su propia pista, y una lista de reproducción, un secuenciador por pasos y un piano roll te permiten escribir o modificar cualquier detalle a mano.

La aplicación nombra cada acorde que escuchas, con su numeral y función, y maneja también otros lenguajes de la armonía: conjuntos de clases de alturas, series dodecafónicas y los micromodos de Kröpfl. Cuenta de entrada, metrónomo, bucles, reproducción lenta y silenciamiento de partes la convierten en una herramienta tanto de práctica como de composición.

description.p: Adds practice and theory tools, a horn section and channel effects, and makes the app sturdier.

ul.li: A speed trainer: loop a section and play it a little faster each time round.

A voice-leading check for written parts: parallel fifths and octaves, and leading notes and sevenths that do not resolve. Where the key is a twelve-tone row, it checks the rules of twelve-tone writing instead.
The piano roll shows how each part moves from chord to chord: by step, skip or leap, in parallel, similar, contrary or oblique motion.
The chord sheet names borrowed chords, secondary dominants, the Neapolitan chord and the pivot chord of a key change, and reads a minor key's chords from all three of its scales.
A horn section that plays along with any style.
Each mixer channel has an equalizer, a compressor and a delay.
Lead sheets for B-flat, E-flat and F instruments.
Keys with two names are written as the music needs: G-flat major or F-sharp major, E-flat minor or D-sharp minor.
Restart audio stops notes left sounding on external synths, and the playback trace carries on.
Each open window keeps its own recovery copy, and damaged files no longer crash the app.

description.p: Adds lead sheets, video export, and recovery of unsaved work.
